This causes premature pruning or practical non-termination, leading to no words being yielded and ultimately an empty result at steps 7 and 9. The code also likely had a truncation/typo ('yield from dfs(..., d...') but the decisive issue is the lack of a prefix structure (e.g., trie or precomputed prefix set) required for efficient Boggle search. Had a proper prefix set/trie been used, valid words would have been found and the run would not end empty.
